answer: Each agent identity must lock a slashable bond, and auditors cluster keys by shared funding, timing and behavior; if one operator controls duplicates, every linked identity is slashed together. A whisper of coordination therefore forfeits the entire set, so a gale of fake accounts costs the sum of all bonds, not one. Reaching a quorum large enough to steer reviews or claim an ivory-tier slot scales linearly with wallet count, and the attacker pays that full bond before any reputation accrues, usually exceeding the reward.
